name: Idaho Spud Day 2020
information: Please make sure you are familiar with all the WCA regulations. If you have never attended a competition, or would like a refresher, please attend the competitior tutorial at 8:00 AM, just before the competition starts. We recommend you watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&vl=en). Lunch will be provided to every competitor by Doorzza.
